typeText:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {M₂ : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring.{u_1} R] [inst_1 : Semiring.{u_2} S]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid.{u_3} M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid.{u_4} M₂] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} R M]
  [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u_4} S M₂] {σ : RingHom.{u_1, u_2} R S} {σ' : RingHom.{u_2, u_1} S R}
  [inst_6 : RingHomInvPair.{u_1, u_2} σ σ'] [inst_7 : RingHomInvPair.{u_2, u_1} σ' σ] (toFun : M → M₂)
  (map_add' :
    ∀ (x y : M), Eq.{u_4 + 1} (toFun (HAdd.hAdd.{u_3, u_3, u_3} x y)) (HAdd.hAdd.{u_4, u_4, u_4} (toFun x) (toFun y)))
  (map_smul' :
    ∀ (m : R) (x : M),
      Eq.{u_4 + 1} (AddHom.toFun.{u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun map_add') (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_3, u_3} m x))
        (HSMul.hSMul.{u_2, u_4, u_4} (σ m) (AddHom.toFun.{u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun map_add') x)))
  (invFun : M₂ → M)
  (left_inv :
    Function.LeftInverse.{u_3 + 1, u_4 + 1} invFun
      (AddHom.toFun.{u_3, u_4}
        (LinearMap.toAddHom.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
          (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun map_add') map_smul'))))
  (right_inv :
    Function.RightInverse.{u_3 + 1, u_4 + 1} invFun
      (AddHom.toFun.{u_3, u_4}
        (LinearMap.toAddHom.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
          (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun map_add') map_smul'))))
  (motive :
    (x : LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} σ M M₂) →
      Eq.{max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1)}
          (LinearEquiv.toEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
            (LinearEquiv.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
              (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun map_add') map_smul') invFun left_inv
              right_inv))
          (LinearEquiv.toEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} x) →
        Prop)
  (x : LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} σ M M₂)
  (h :
    Eq.{max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1)}
      (LinearEquiv.toEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
        (LinearEquiv.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
          (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun map_add') map_smul') invFun left_inv
          right_inv))
      (LinearEquiv.toEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} x)),
  (∀ (toFun_1 : M → M₂)
      (map_add'_1 :
        ∀ (x y : M),
          Eq.{u_4 + 1} (toFun_1 (HAdd.hAdd.{u_3, u_3, u_3} x y)) (HAdd.hAdd.{u_4, u_4, u_4} (toFun_1 x) (toFun_1 y)))
      (map_smul'_1 :
        ∀ (m : R) (x : M),
          Eq.{u_4 + 1}
            (AddHom.toFun.{u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun_1 map_add'_1) (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_3, u_3} m x))
            (HSMul.hSMul.{u_2, u_4, u_4} (σ m) (AddHom.toFun.{u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun_1 map_add'_1) x)))
      (invFun_1 : M₂ → M)
      (left_inv_1 :
        Function.LeftInverse.{u_3 + 1, u_4 + 1} invFun_1
          (AddHom.toFun.{u_3, u_4}
            (LinearMap.toAddHom.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
              (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun_1 map_add'_1) map_smul'_1))))
      (right_inv_1 :
        Function.RightInverse.{u_3 + 1, u_4 + 1} invFun_1
          (AddHom.toFun.{u_3, u_4}
            (LinearMap.toAddHom.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
              (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun_1 map_add'_1) map_smul'_1))))
      (h :
        Eq.{max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1)}
          (LinearEquiv.toEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
            (LinearEquiv.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
              (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun map_add') map_smul') invFun left_inv
              right_inv))
          (LinearEquiv.toEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
            (LinearEquiv.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
              (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun_1 map_add'_1) map_smul'_1) invFun_1
              left_inv_1 right_inv_1))),
      motive
        (LinearEquiv.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
          (LinearMap.mk.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (AddHom.mk.{u_3, u_4} toFun_1 map_add'_1) map_smul'_1) invFun_1 left_inv_1
          right_inv_1)
        h) →
    motive x h
